docs: Clean-room CSS scroll-snap. No Motion UI or Motion+ source. Alignment is the browser's. Smooth scrolling is off when motion-preference says reduce. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite motion-preference or another file the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
